entries.title: v1.4.272
entries.note: More reliable bots that pick up where they left off ✨ 🤖 Bots recover more reliably after interruptions. Conversations paused by usage limits can continue automatically after an account switch or restart. Resume works for chats interrupted by a crash or restart, and with Resume work on restart enabled, terminal workers can return to their saved conversations even if their terminals were lost. Usage-limit recovery · Chat recovery · Worker recovery 🌐 Use the same browser tools across machines. Extensions such as 1Password now work in SSH workspace tabs and paired-server tabs opened on This device . Drop files from your desktop into server-streamed pages, and let agents on SSH hosts or paired servers upload and download files using paths on their own host. entries.title: v1.4.268
entries.note: We shipped more than one release today. Check out 1.4.267 and 1.4.266 too. Bots on more agents, richer Slack & a faster Orca ✨ Bots can now run on Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Hermes, Slack gets scheduling and canvases, and Orca does less work in the background so it feels quicker. 🤖 Run bots on more agents: Bots can run on Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Hermes, and OpenCode 2.x bots get their standing instructions. New bots get an identity card, and Soul & Memory have redesigned editors. 🖼️ Send images and files: Attach images and files in bot chats, group chats and item comments, including to a bot on a paired computer. Images on a Slack request reach the agent as images. 💬 More from Slack: orca slack post --at schedules a post for later, and new pin , canvas , list and scheduled commands cover pins, canvases and lists. entries.title: v1.4.264
entries.note: Previous release: 1.4.263 — Lighter chat startup, Hermes in Chat and browser extension side panels. Chat commands find their workspace ✨ This desktop patch corrects workspace selection when a Chat UI agent runs Orca commands from a folder outside its workspace. 💬 Keep browser work with the chat: When Orca can locate the chat, commands such as opening a browser tab use that chat's workspace, including folder workspaces, rather than the workspace currently in focus. Usage notes If a chat's workspace cannot be resolved, browser commands without a target are refused. Run the command from the intended workspace folder or pass --worktree ; commands acting on an existing page also accept --page using an ID from orca tab list --json . entries.title: Orca Mobile Android android-v0.0.68
entries.note: Previous Android release: 0.0.67 More control over chats and terminals from your phone ✨ Android 0.0.68 brings together improvements for starting agents, following their work and returning to earlier sessions. With an updated paired host, you can choose the workflow you want and do more of the follow-up from your phone. 💬 Start in Chat or CLI: Choose a surface in the New Tab sheet instead of relying entirely on the host's default. Your phone remembers your choice; agents that cannot run in Chat still open in the CLI. 🔎 Find and revisit past work: Agent History adds agent and sort filters, searches across the whole project, and offers to resume interrupted chats after the computer restarts. 🔔 See which agent needs a read: Unread bells appear on workspace agent rows and session tabs, including collapsed groups.
